title.zh: UJIIndoorLoc，官方划分（训练 19,937 / 验证 1,111 条）

protocol.name: official
protocol.summary: the dataset's own train/test files (the setting of most published numbers)

skips.en: model-based: the dataset does not publish the access-point positions
skips.zh: 基于模型的方法：数据集未公开 AP 位置

notes.en: Errors are in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) metres, the dataset's own coordinates, in which UJIIndoorLoc results are usually reported; multiply by meta['ground_scale'] = 0.7661 (cos 39.99 deg) for ground metres (e.g. WKNN 8.794 -> 6.737 m). The IPIN score adds 15 m per floor and 50 m for a wrong building (75th percentile).
notes.zh: 误差单位为 EPSG:3857（Web Mercator）米，即数据集自身的坐标，UJIIndoorLoc 的结果通常以此报告；乘以 meta['ground_scale'] = 0.7661（cos 39.99°）得到地面米（例如 WKNN 8.794 → 6.737 m）。IPIN 分数：每错一层加 15 m、楼栋错加 50 m 后的第 75 百分位。

mean_error.definition: mean 2-D Euclidean error, as reported by each paper; the dataset's own coordinates are EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) metres, 0.766 ground metres each

floor_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose floor is estimated correctly (floor hit rate)

building_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose building is estimated correctly

std_error.definition: standard deviation of the 2-D error, as reported

mean_penalized_error.definition: mean of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)

p25_penalized_error.definition: 25th percentile of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)

median_penalized_error.definition: median of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)

p75_penalized_error.definition: 75th percentile of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)

p95_penalized_error.definition: 95th percentile of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)

max_penalized_error.definition: maximum of the error with 4 m per wrong floor and 50 m for a wrong building (EvAAL-ETRI 2015 rules; indoorloc.evaluation.scoring.penalized_errors)
